web-guide-idea-1.audience: NRIs and devotees who cannot make this particular visit.
web-guide-idea-1.offer: Sell a guided window into the temple atmosphere, with a named location, language and clear start time. People are booking your thoughtful hosting and permitted coverage; temple access itself may be free.
web-guide-idea-1.steps.0: Confirm filming permission and choose a permitted route.
web-guide-idea-1.steps.1: Open with the temple’s local story and what viewers will see.
web-guide-idea-1.steps.2: Walk slowly, pause for details and end with audience questions.
web-guide-idea-1.equipment: A phone with a good camera, stable mobile data, a power bank and optional earphones with a microphone. Check reception at the actual location first.
web-guide-idea-1.returnReason: Create a calendar of different temples or festival visits. Explain what makes the next visit distinct so a follower has a reason to book again.
web-guide-idea-1.promotion: Share a short permitted clip of a carving or courtyard and announce the full visit’s date. Never imply the ticket purchases blessings or privileged temple access.
